signIn.describe: Resident of Al-Noor Residency: bills, payments and receipts for their own flat

demoLink.linked: Demo: linked with the society office app in this browser, so the office sees what you send.
demoLink.local: Demo: the office app could not be reached, so what you send stays in this app.

home.title: Home
home.pendingNote: {{amount}} you sent is being checked. It counts once the office verifies it.
home.needsInfoTitle: The office needs more from you
home.cashNote: You can also pay cash at the office: {{counter}}.
home.onlineLater: Online payment is not available yet (planned for stage {{gate}}).
home.paidInAdvance: You have paid in advance. The credit settles your next bills, oldest first.

bills.title: Your bills
bills.intro: Every bill for the flats you pay for. Total to pay now: {{total}}.
bills.emptyBody: Bills appear here once the society issues them.

bill.title: {{period}} bill
bill.left: Left to pay on this bill
bill.positionLine: Earlier balance {{previous}} + this month {{current}} = total to pay {{total}}
bill.positionRule: The earlier balance is shown apart: it is never added to this bill's lines.

history.title: Receipts and proofs
history.intro: What the office has verified (with its receipt), and every proof you have sent.
history.noReceipts: No receipts yet. A receipt is issued when the office verifies your payment.
history.noProofs: You have not sent any proof.

chequeState.received: Received at the office. Not a receipt of payment: nothing is paid until it clears.
chequeState.deposited: Deposited at the bank. Not paid until it clears.
chequeState.exception_pending: Being checked at the bank. Not paid until it clears.
chequeState.returned: Returned by the bank ({{reason}}). Nothing was paid; please pay again.
chequeState.reversed: Returned after clearing: the payment was reversed and the bill is open again.

pay.title: Pay your dues
pay.intro: Transfer the total to the society's verified account, then send the receipt here.
pay.detailsIntro: The only account to pay your dues into.
pay.detailsNext: Already transferred? Send the proof so the office can check it.
pay.noPayee: The society has no verified account at the moment. Please contact the office.
pay.changedBody: Do not use the old account any more.
pay.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text instead.
pay.qrLabel: QR code of the payment instruction
pay.qrDemo: Demo: a fictional account. Never use it for a real payment.
pay.onlyThisAccount: Pay only into this account. Nobody from the society or PropertyOS will ask you to pay into any other account.
pay.proofIntro: A photo or PDF of the bank's receipt. The office checks it against the bank before it counts.
pay.yourReferenceHelp: As shown on your bank's receipt.
pay.fileHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 5 MB
pay.fileType: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP image or a PDF.
pay.fileSize: The file must be 5 MB or smaller.
pay.pendingRule: After you send it, your payment shows as "Pending verification". It is marked paid only when the office verifies it, and then you get a receipt.
pay.sent: Proof sent. It is pending verification.
pay.duplicateBody: You already sent this proof ({{ref}}). Send it again only if the office asked you to.
pay.cashBody: Bring cash to {{counter}}. You get a receipt at the counter.
pay.cashLimit: Up to {{max}} in cash per receipt.
pay.cashReceipt: Cash is receipted straight away; nothing needs to be sent here.
pay.cashOff: The office does not take cash at present. Please pay by bank transfer.
pay.onlineBody: Card and wallet payments are not available for your society yet.

proof.title: Your payment proof
proof.sentBody: The office checks it against the bank. Your payment counts once it is verified, and you get a receipt.

explain.submitted: Pending verification: the office has not opened it yet. It is not marked paid until it is verified.
explain.under_review: The office is checking it against the bank.
explain.needs_information: The office needs more from you. Send the proof again below.
explain.rejected: Not accepted. Nothing was recorded as paid.
explain.awaiting_bank_evidence: The office checked your proof and is waiting for the transfer to appear on the association's bank statement. It is not marked paid until then.
explain.exception_pending: The office is checking it against the bank.

proof.rejectedNext: If you paid, contact the office or send a new proof with the correct receipt.
proof.resubmitted: Proof sent again. It is pending verification.

steps.awaiting_bank_evidence: Checked; waiting for the bank statement

statement.title: Your statement
statement.intro: Your own charges and payments from {{from}} to {{to}}

tour.name: Your dues, step by step
tour.summary: This month's bill, the exact total, how to pay, and where your proof stands.

bill.title: This month's bill
bill.body: The society's maintenance bill for your flat, with its due date and whether it is paid.

total.title: The exact total
total.body: This month's bill plus any earlier balance, less any credit. This is what to transfer.

pay.title: Pay
pay.body: Shows the society's verified account to transfer to, then lets you send the bank's receipt.

status.title: Where your payment stands
status.body: A proof shows "Pending verification" until the office checks it against the bank. Then a receipt appears here.

navigation.title: Find your way
navigation.body: Bills, receipts and your statement are always in the menu.
navigation.bodyMobile: Bills, receipts and your statement are in the bar at the bottom; Pay is the round button.

help.title: Help any time
help.body: Replay this tour from the help button. Text size is in your account menu.
